topics.description: A Minnesota Medicaid operator is under investigation for alleged fraud after its bankruptcy-to-riches rise. The operator is accused of hiding millions of dollars in assets.
topics.reason: The investigation is trending due to the large amount of money involved and the operator's sudden change in fortune.

topics.description: There are allegations of COVID-19 meal fraud involving U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar. The allegations claim that Omar was involved in a $250M COVID-19 meal fraud scheme.
topics.reason: The allegations are trending due to the high profile nature of the accused and the large amount of money involved.
